{{Quote|Maybe this trinket will help you learn a thing or two. I have had this since I was young but were never able to find a way to unlock it.|[[Ha'zel]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RtAoP" />}}
'''Allya's Holocron''' was a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] presumably created by [[Allya/Legends|Allya]],<ref name="SWG:AH" /> an [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who founded the [[Witches of Dathomir]].<ref name="COPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Allya's Holocron appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Allya's Holocron was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Witches of Dathomir Theme Park|Witches of Dathomir Theme Park]]," introduced upon the release of the [[W:c:swg:Game Update 19|Game Update 19]] on [[December 14]], [[2010]].<ref name="GU19">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1160720|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 19}}</ref>
